== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L2322-L2326
  2322  theorem soundness [LevelOracle] (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) :
  2323      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr}, Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e') ∧
  2324      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr}, DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b) ∧
  2325      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr}, Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T) :=
  2326    ⟨red_sound, defeq_sound, infer_sound⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Motive.lean#L51-L84
    51  /-- **`Red`'s claim**: on a subject that is not the point, reduction
    52  preserves the invariant and the denotation.  Nothing is claimed of a
    53  proof. -/
    54  def RedSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (e e' : Expr) : Prop :=
    55    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e → interp m.M φ ρ e ≠ pt →
    56      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e' ∧ interp m.M φ ρ e = interp m.M φ ρ e'
    57  
    58  /-- **`DefEqLams`' claim**: two well-denoted sides have
    59  equal denotations — unconditionally, the point included. -/
    60  def LamsSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    61    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ a → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ b →
    62      interp m.M φ ρ a = interp m.M φ ρ b
    63  
    64  /-- **`DefEq`'s claim**: two well-denoted sides that are not the point
    65  have equal denotations.  (Two proofs are the point.) -/
    66  def DefEqSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    67    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ a → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ b →
    68      interp m.M φ ρ a ≠ pt → interp m.M φ ρ b ≠ pt → interp m.M φ ρ a = interp m.M φ ρ b
    69  
    70  /-- **`DefEqIn`'s claim**: two well-denoted members of one
    71  well-denoted type have equal denotations — unconditionally, since a
    72  type's members are all the point or none. -/
    73  def DefEqInSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (T a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    74    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ T → IsTy (interp m.M φ ρ T) →
    75      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ a → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ b →
    76      interp m.M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T → interp m.M φ ρ b ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T →
    77      interp m.M φ ρ a = interp m.M φ ρ b
    78  
    79  /-- **`Infer`'s claim**: the term and its type are well-denoted, the
    80  type is a type, and the term's denotation is a member of the type's. -/
    81  def InferSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (e T : Expr) : Prop :=
    82    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ →
    83      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e ∧ WellDenoted m.M φ ρ T ∧ IsTy (interp m.M φ ρ T) ∧
    84        interp m.M φ ρ e ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T

  2332      interp m.M φ ρ e ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T :=

== whitepaper/Fragment/Probe.lean#L65-L72
    65  /-- `fun (P : Prop) (h : P) => c`, for `c` not the point: a graph, whose
    66  application at `False` is the point (an abstraction over an empty
    67  domain) and at `True` is not — a body whose point-ness varies with the

    69  theorem mixed_lam {c : V} (hc : c ≠ pt) :
    70      lamV (typeU 0) (fun P => lamV P fun _ => c) ≠ pt ∧

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L2202-L2311
  2202  theorem red_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr},
  2203      Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e'
  2204    | _, _, _, .refl => Red.refl_sound
  2205    | _, _, _, .trans h₁ h₂ => Red.trans_sound (red_sound h₁) (red_sound h₂)
  2206    | _, _, _, .appFn h => Red.appFn_sound (red_sound h)
  2207    | _, _, _, .beta => Red.beta_sound
  2208    | _, _, _, .zeta => Red.zeta_sound

  2226        hcij hcijk husj hmlen hpis' hresM (infer_sound hIM)

  2228        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD' p hp)) hres hshape hrps (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
  2229    | _, _, _, .iotaSlot hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij husj hmlen hpis' hresM
  2230        hdoms' htys' hI' hD' hlv hP hres hshape hrps hX =>
  2231      Red.iotaSlot_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij husj
  2232        hmlen hpis' hresM hdoms' htys' (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI' p hp))
  2233        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD' p hp)) hlv (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hP p hp)) hres hshape hrps
  2234        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
  2235    | _, _, _, .iotaNestedSlot hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij hcijk husj hmlen
  2236        hpis' hresM hdoms' htys' hI' hD' _ _ _ hres hshape hrps hX =>
  2237      Red.iotaNestedSlot_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor hinst
  2238        hcij hcijk husj hmlen hpis' hresM hdoms' htys' (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI' p hp))
  2239        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD' p hp)) hres hshape hrps (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
  2240    | _, _, _, .iotaStrict hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij husj hmlen hpis'
  2241        hresM hdM hI₀ hk₀ hls₀ hd₀ hpis₀ hlvl hlv hP hres hshape hrps hX =>
  2242      Red.iotaStrict_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor hinst
  2243        hcij husj hmlen hpis' hresM hdM hI₀ hk₀ hls₀ hd₀ hpis₀ hlvl hlv
  2244        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hP p hp)) hres hshape hrps (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
  2245    | _, _, _, .iotaNestedStrict hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hinst hcij hcijk husj
  2246        hmlen hpis' hresM hdM hI₀ hk₀ hls₀ hd₀ hpis₀ hlvl _ _ _ hres hshape hrps hX =>
  2247      Red.iotaNestedStrict_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor
  2248        hinst hcij hcijk husj hmlen hpis' hresM hdM hI₀ hk₀ hls₀ hd₀ hpis₀ hlvl hres hshape hrps
  2249        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
  2250    | _, _, _, .iotaK hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hrl hk _ _ _ _ =>
  2251      Red.iotaK_sound hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hrl hk
  2252  theorem defeq_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr},
  2253      DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b
  2254    | _, _, _, .refl => DefEq.refl_sound
  2255    | _, _, _, .symm h => DefEq.symm_sound (defeq_sound h)
  2256    | _, _, _, .redL hr h => DefEq.redL_sound (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound h)
  2257    | _, _, _, .sort h => DefEq.sort_sound h
  2258    | _, _, _, .const h => DefEq.const_sound h
  2259    | _, _, _, .pi hA hB => DefEq.pi_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hB)
  2260    | _, _, _, .lam hA hb ht₁ ht₂ ht =>
  2261      DefEq.lam_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hb) (infer_sound ht₁) (infer_sound ht₂)
  2262        (defeq_sound ht)
  2263    | _, _, _, .lamProp hA hb hs hu hu0 =>
  2264      DefEq.lamProp_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hb) (infer_sound hs) (red_sound hu) hu0
  2265    | _, _, _, .etaProp htb hr hA hbody hs hu hu0 =>
  2266      DefEq.etaProp_sound (infer_sound htb) (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hbody)
  2267        (infer_sound hs) (red_sound hu) hu0
  2268    | _, _, _, .lamConst hA hb hc₁ hc₂ =>
  2269      DefEq.lamConst_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hb) hc₁ hc₂
  2270    | _, _, _, .appIn hf hI hr ha =>
  2271      DefEq.appIn_sound (defeq_sound hf) (infer_sound hI) (red_sound hr) (defeqIn_sound ha)
  2272    | _, _, _, .app hf ha => DefEq.app_sound (defeq_sound hf) (defeq_sound ha)
  2273    | _, _, _, .eta htb hr hA hbody ht₁ htB =>
  2274      DefEq.eta_sound (fun ρ hs _ _ => (infer_sound htb ρ hs).2) (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound hA)
  2275        (defeq_sound hbody)
  2276        (infer_sound ht₁) (defeq_sound htB)
  2277    | _, _, _, .proofIrrel hta htta hu hu0 _ _ _ _ =>
  2278      DefEq.proofIrrel_sound (infer_sound hta) (infer_sound htta) (red_sound hu) hu0
  2279    | _, _, _, .lams h => DefEq.lams_sound (defeqLams_sound h)
  2280  
  2281  theorem defeqLams_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr},
  2282      DefEqLams env Γ a b → LamsSem m φ Γ a b
  2283    | _, _, _, .refl => DefEqLams.refl_sound
  2284    | _, _, _, .inner hA hb ht₁ ht₂ ht =>
  2285      DefEqLams.inner_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hb) (infer_sound ht₁) (infer_sound ht₂)
  2286        (defeq_sound ht)
  2287    | _, _, _, .outer hA hb => DefEqLams.outer_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeqLams_sound hb)
  2288  
  2289  theorem defeqIn_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {T a b : Expr},
  2290      DefEqIn env Γ T a b → DefEqInSem m φ Γ T a b
  2291    | _, _, _, _, .of h => DefEqIn.of_sound (defeq_sound h)
  2292    | _, _, _, _, .symm h => DefEqIn.symm_sound (defeqIn_sound h)
  2293    | _, _, _, _, .lam hr hb => DefEqIn.lam_sound (red_sound hr) (defeqIn_sound hb)
  2294    | _, _, _, _, .eta hr hb => DefEqIn.eta_sound (red_sound hr) (defeqIn_sound hb)
  2295  
  2296  theorem infer_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr},
  2297      Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T
  2298    | _, _, _, .bvar h => Infer.bvar_sound h
  2299    | _, _, _, .sort => Infer.sort_sound
  2300    | _, _, _, .const hfind hls => Infer.const_sound hfind hls
  2301    | _, _, _, .pi hA hu hB hv =>
  2302      Infer.pi_sound (infer_sound hA) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hB) (red_sound hv)
  2303    | _, _, _, .lam hA hu hb =>
  2304      Infer.lam_sound (infer_sound hA) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hb)
  2305    | _, _, _, .app hf hr ha hd =>
  2306      Infer.app_sound (infer_sound hf) (red_sound hr) (infer_sound ha) (defeq_sound hd)
  2307    | _, _, _, .letE hT hu hv hd hb =>
  2308      Infer.letE_sound (infer_sound hT) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hv) (defeq_sound hd)
  2309        (infer_sound hb)
  2310  
  2311  end

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L111-L132
   111  theorem beta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A b a : Expr} :
   112      RedSem m φ Γ (.app (.lam A b) a) (b.inst a) := by
   113    intro ρ _ hw hn
   114    rw [WellDenoted_app] at hw
   115    obtain ⟨hl, ha, p, A', B', hslot, hmem, -, -⟩ := hw
   116    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hl
   117    obtain ⟨-, -, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := hl
   118    have hlam := fn_ne_pt hn
   119    have hval : interp m.M φ ρ (.lam A b) =
   120        graph (fun x => interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b) (interp m.M φ ρ A) := by
   121      rw [interp_lam] at hlam ⊢; exact lamV_eq_graph hlam
   122    have hp : p = false := by
   123      cases p
   124      · rfl
   125      · exact absurd (eq_pt_of_mem_piR_true hslot) hlam
   126    subst hp
   127    have hown : interp m.M φ ρ (.lam A b) ∈ˢ piR false (interp m.M φ ρ A) B := by
   128      rw [hval, piR_false]; exact graph_mem_piSet hfib
   129    have haA : interp m.M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A := by
   130      rw [piR_dom_unique hown hslot]; exact hmem
   131    refine ⟨(WellDenoted_inst0 m.M φ ha).mpr (hbody _ haA), ?_⟩
   132    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, app_lamV haA, interp_inst0]

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L134-L142
   134  /-- **ζ, with no certificate**: the `let` and its
   135  reduct denote alike at every environment (`interp_zeta`), so neither
   136  the point hypothesis nor the context is used; the reduct's invariant is
   137  the `let`'s, through the substitution lemma. -/
   138  theorem zeta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {T v b : Expr} :
   139      RedSem m φ Γ (.letE T v b) (b.inst v) := by
   140    intro ρ _ hw _
   141    rw [WellDenoted_letE] at hw
   142    exact ⟨(WellDenoted_inst0 m.M φ hw.1).mpr hw.2, interp_zeta m.M φ T v b ρ⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L165-L171
   165  /-- Reduce, then continue — sound with no typing: the side is not the
   166  point, so its reduction is. -/
   167  theorem redL_sound {Γ : List Expr} {a a' b : Expr}
   168      (hr : RedSem m φ Γ a a') (h : DefEqSem m φ Γ a' b) : DefEqSem m φ Γ a b := by
   169    intro ρ hs ha hb hna hnb
   170    obtain ⟨ha', he⟩ := hr ρ hs ha hna
   171    exact he.trans (h ρ hs ha' hb (he ▸ hna) hnb)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L181-L198
   181  /-- **`∀`-congruence, with no premise beyond domains and bodies**:
   182  a `∀`'s value is a function of its domain's and fibres' values
   183  (`SetLib.piV_congr`), and both are types, never the point. -/
   184  theorem pi_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Expr}
   185      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₁ A₂) (hB : DefEqSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂) :
   186      DefEqSem m φ Γ (.pi A₁ B₁) (.pi A₂ B₂) := by
   187    intro ρ hs h₁ h₂ _ _
   188    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at h₁ h₂
   189    have heA := hA ρ hs h₁.1 h₂.1 h₁.2.1.ne_pt h₂.2.1.ne_pt
   190    have hfib : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₂ →
   191        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) B₁ = interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) B₂ := by
   192      intro x hx
   193      have hx₁ : x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₁ := by rw [heA]; exact hx
   194      exact hB (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, h₂.1, h₂.2.1, hx⟩) (h₁.2.2.1 x hx₁)
   195        (h₂.2.2.1 x hx) (h₁.2.2.2 x hx₁).ne_pt (h₂.2.2.2 x hx).ne_pt
   196    simp only [interp_pi]
   197    rw [heA]
   198    exact piV_congr hfib

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L200-L220
   200  /-- **Lambda congruence, typed**: the two bodies lie in one type
   201  at every value of the variable — their inferred types are equal there
   202  — so they are both the point or neither is, and where neither is the
   203  bodies' claim makes them equal.  Neither lambda need be a graph. -/
   204  theorem lam_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ t₁ t₂ : Expr}
   205      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₁ A₂) (hb : DefEqSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂)
   206      (ht₁ : InferSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ t₁) (ht₂ : InferSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) b₂ t₂)
   207      (ht : DefEqSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) t₁ t₂) :
   208      DefEqSem m φ Γ (.lam A₁ b₁) (.lam A₂ b₂) := by
   209    intro ρ hs h₁ h₂ _ _
   210    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at h₁ h₂
   211    have heA := hA ρ hs h₁.1 h₂.1 h₁.2.1.ne_pt h₂.2.1.ne_pt
   212    simp only [interp_lam]
   213    rw [heA]
   214    apply lamV_congr
   215    intro x hx
   216    have hs' : Sat m.M φ (A₂ :: Γ) (cons x ρ) := (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, h₂.1, h₂.2.1, hx⟩
   217    obtain ⟨hw₁, hwt₁, hT₁, hm₁⟩ := ht₁ _ hs'
   218    obtain ⟨hw₂, hwt₂, hT₂, hm₂⟩ := ht₂ _ hs'
   219    rw [ht _ hs' hwt₁ hwt₂ hT₁.ne_pt hT₂.ne_pt] at hm₁
   220    exact hT₂.eq_of_ne_pt hm₁ hm₂ (hb _ hs' hw₁ hw₂)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L233-L254
   233  /-- **Application congruence**: the two heads are equal graphs, so the
   234  two arguments lie in one domain, which is a type — both arguments are
   235  the point, or neither is. -/
   236  theorem app_sound {Γ : List Expr} {f₁ a₁ f₂ a₂ : Expr}
   237      (hf : DefEqSem m φ Γ f₁ f₂) (ha : DefEqSem m φ Γ a₁ a₂) :
   238      DefEqSem m φ Γ (.app f₁ a₁) (.app f₂ a₂) := by
   239    intro ρ hs h₁ h₂ hn₁ hn₂
   240    obtain ⟨A₁, B₁, hs₁, hm₁, hT₁⟩ := app_slot h₁ hn₁
   241    obtain ⟨A₂, B₂, hs₂, hm₂, -⟩ := app_slot h₂ hn₂
   242    have h₁' := h₁
   243    have h₂' := h₂
   244    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h₁' h₂'
   245    have heF := hf ρ hs h₁'.1 h₂'.1 (fn_ne_pt hn₁) (fn_ne_pt hn₂)
   246    rw [← heF] at hs₂
   247    have hA : A₁ = A₂ := piSet_dom_unique hs₁ hs₂
   248    rw [← hA] at hm₂
   249    have heA : interp m.M φ ρ a₁ = interp m.M φ ρ a₂ := by
   250      rcases hT₁ with hT | hT
   251      · rw [eq_pt_of_mem_univ_zero hT hm₁, eq_pt_of_mem_univ_zero hT hm₂]
   252      · exact ha ρ hs h₁'.2.1 h₂'.2.1 (ne_pt_of_mem_strict hT hm₁) (ne_pt_of_mem_strict hT hm₂)
   253    simp only [interp_app]
   254    rw [heF, heA]

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L391-L436
   391  /-- **η, typed**: at every value of the variable the lambda's
   392  body and `b` applied lie in one type — the body's inferred type is the
   393  `∀`'s fibre — so they are both the point or neither is, and where
   394  neither is the body's claim makes them equal; a member of a function space is
   395  the abstraction of its applications (`SetLib.lamV_eta`). -/
   396  theorem eta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B t₁ : Expr}
   397      (htb : ∀ ρ, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ b → interp m.M φ ρ b ≠ pt →
   398        WellDenoted m.M φ ρ tb ∧ IsTy (interp m.M φ ρ tb) ∧
   399          interp m.M φ ρ b ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ tb)
   400      (hr : RedSem m φ Γ tb (.pi A₂ B))
   401      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₂ A₁)
   402      (hbody : DefEqSem m φ (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (.app (b.liftN 1) (.bvar 0)))
   403      (ht₁ : InferSem m φ (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ t₁) (htB : DefEqSem m φ (A₁ :: Γ) t₁ B) :
   404      DefEqSem m φ Γ (.lam A₁ b₁) b := by
   405    intro ρ hs hlam hwb _ hnb
   406    obtain ⟨hwtb, hTtb, hmemb⟩ := htb ρ hs hwb hnb
   407    obtain ⟨hwpi, hepi⟩ := hr ρ hs hwtb hTtb.ne_pt
   408    rw [hepi, interp_pi] at hmemb
   409    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hwpi
   410    have hlam' := hlam
   411    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam'
   412    have heA := hA ρ hs hwpi.1 hlam'.1 hwpi.2.1.ne_pt hlam'.2.1.ne_pt
   413    have hsh : ∀ x, shiftE 1 0 (cons x ρ) = ρ := by
   414      intro x; funext i; simp [shiftE]
   415    have hlift : ∀ x, interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) (b.liftN 1) = interp m.M φ ρ b := by
   416      intro x; rw [interp_liftN, hsh]
   417    have hpt : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₁ →
   418        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b₁ = SetLib.app (interp m.M φ ρ b) x := by
   419      intro x hx
   420      have hx₂ : x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₂ := by rw [heA]; exact hx
   421      have hs' : Sat m.M φ (A₁ :: Γ) (cons x ρ) :=
   422        (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hlam'.1, hlam'.2.1, hx⟩
   423      have happ : WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) (.app (b.liftN 1) (.bvar 0)) := by
   424        rw [WellDenoted_app]
   425        exact ⟨(WellDenoted_liftN m.M φ 1 b 0 (cons x ρ)).mpr (by rw [hsh]; exact hwb), trivial,
   426          _, interp m.M φ ρ A₂, fun y => interp m.M φ (cons y ρ) B,
   427          by rw [hlift]; exact hmemb, hx₂, fun hp => propB_eq_true.mp hp, fun _ => hwpi.2.1⟩
   428      obtain ⟨hwb₁, hwt₁, hT₁, hm₁⟩ := ht₁ _ hs'
   429      rw [htB _ hs' hwt₁ (hwpi.2.2.1 x hx₂) hT₁.ne_pt (hwpi.2.2.2 x hx₂).ne_pt] at hm₁
   430      have hm₂ : interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) (.app (b.liftN 1) (.bvar 0)) ∈ˢ
   431          interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) B := by
   432        rw [interp_app, interp_bvar, cons_zero, hlift]; exact app_mem_piV hmemb hx₂
   433      rw [(hwpi.2.2.2 x hx₂).eq_of_ne_pt hm₁ hm₂ (hbody _ hs' hwb₁ happ), interp_app, interp_bvar,
   434        cons_zero, hlift]
   435    rw [interp_lam, lamV_congr hpt, ← heA]
   436    exact lamV_eta hmemb fun x hx => hwpi.2.2.2 x hx

   576  theorem lamV_eta {A f : V} {B : V → V} (hf : f ∈ˢ piV A B) (hB : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → IsTy (B x)) :
   577      lamV A (fun x => app f x) = f := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L579-L589
   579  /-- **Proof irrelevance claims nothing**: a side whose type's sort is
   580  `Prop` is the point, and the claim is about sides that are not. -/
   581  theorem proofIrrel_sound [LevelOracle] {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b : Expr} {u : Level}
   582      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (htta : InferSem m φ Γ ta tta)
   583      (hu : RedSem m φ Γ tta (.sort u)) (hu0 : LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true) :
   584      DefEqSem m φ Γ a b := by
   585    intro ρ hs _ _ hna _
   586    obtain ⟨-, hmemT⟩ := Infer.mem_typeU_of htta hu hs
   587    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hmem⟩ := hta ρ hs
   588    rw [eval_eq_of_oracle hu0, Level.eval_zero, mem_typeU_zero] at hmemT
   589    exact absurd (eq_pt_of_mem_univ_zero hmemT hmem) hna

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L292-L306
   292  theorem pi_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level}
   293      (hA : InferSem m φ Γ A s) (hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (.sort u))
   294      (hB : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) B t) (hv : RedSem m φ (A :: Γ) t (.sort v)) :
   295      InferSem m φ Γ (.pi A B) (.sort (.imax u v)) := by
   296    intro ρ hs
   297    obtain ⟨hwA, hmemA⟩ := mem_typeU_of hA hu hs
   298    have hTA := IsTy_of_mem_typeU hmemA
   299    have hbody : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A →
   300        WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) B ∧ interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) B ∈ˢ typeU (Level.eval φ v) :=
   301      fun x hx => mem_typeU_of hB hv ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwA, hTA, hx⟩)
   302    refine ⟨?_, trivial, Or.inr (strict_typeU _), ?_⟩
   303    · rw [WellDenoted_pi]
   304      exact ⟨hwA, hTA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).1, fun x hx => IsTy_of_mem_typeU (hbody x hx).2⟩
   305    · rw [interp_pi, interp_sort, Level.eval_imax]
   306      exact piV_mem_typeU hmemA fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2

   595  /-- **`∀`-formation in the sorts' sets `typeU`**, with no regime

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L308-L329
   308  /-- **Lambda**: Lean's rule.  The body's type is a type (`InferSem`), which
   309  is all `lamV_mem` asks of the fibres. -/
   310  theorem lam_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt : Expr} {u : Level}
   311      (hA : InferSem m φ Γ A s) (hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (.sort u))
   312      (hb : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) b bt) :
   313      InferSem m φ Γ (.lam A b) (.pi A bt) := by
   314    intro ρ hs
   315    obtain ⟨hwA, hmemA⟩ := mem_typeU_of hA hu hs
   316    have hTA := IsTy_of_mem_typeU hmemA
   317    have hbody : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A →
   318        WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) b ∧ WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∧
   319        IsTy (interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt) ∧
   320        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt :=
   321      fun x hx => hb (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwA, hTA, hx⟩)
   322    refine ⟨?_, ?_, by rw [interp_pi]; exact IsTy_piV, ?_⟩
   323    · rw [WellDenoted_lam]
   324      exact ⟨hwA, hTA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).1, fun x => interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt,
   325        fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.2, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1⟩
   326    · rw [WellDenoted_pi]
   327      exact ⟨hwA, hTA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.1, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1⟩
   328    · rw [interp_lam, interp_pi]
   329      exact lamV_mem (fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.2) fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L331-L349
   331  theorem app_sound {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr}
   332      (hf : InferSem m φ Γ f tf) (hr : RedSem m φ Γ tf (.pi A B))
   333      (ha : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ ta A) :
   334      InferSem m φ Γ (.app f a) (B.inst a) := by
   335    intro ρ hs
   336    obtain ⟨hwf, hwtf, hTtf, hmemf⟩ := hf ρ hs
   337    obtain ⟨hwpi, hepi⟩ := hr ρ hs hwtf hTtf.ne_pt
   338    rw [hepi, interp_pi] at hmemf
   339    have hwpi' := hwpi
   340    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hwpi'
   341    obtain ⟨hwA, hTA, hwB, hfib⟩ := hwpi'
   342    obtain ⟨hwa, hwta, hTta, hmema⟩ := ha ρ hs
   343    rw [hd ρ hs hwta hwA hTta.ne_pt hTA.ne_pt] at hmema
   344    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 m.M φ hwa).mpr (hwB _ hmema), ?_, ?_⟩
   345    · rw [WellDenoted_app]
   346      exact ⟨hwf, hwa, _, _, _, hmemf, hmema, fun hp => propB_eq_true.mp hp, fun _ => hTA⟩
   347    · rw [interp_inst0]; exact hfib _ hmema
   348    · rw [interp_app, interp_inst0]
   349      exact app_mem_piV hmemf hmema

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L351-L367
   351  /-- **`let`, by substitution**: the body with the value
   352  substituted carries the claim, and the `let` denotes what it denotes
   353  (`interp_zeta`); its invariant is the `let`'s (`WellDenoted_letE`
   354  against `WellDenoted_inst0`).  The type checks on the value (`hT`,
   355  `hu`, `hv`, `hd`) are not used: `interp` reads no type, and the body
   356  is inferred at the value itself, not at a variable of the type. -/
   357  theorem letE_sound {Γ : List Expr} {T v b s tv B : Expr} {u : Level}
   358      (_hT : InferSem m φ Γ T s) (_hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (.sort u))
   359      (hv : InferSem m φ Γ v tv) (_hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ tv T)
   360      (hb : InferSem m φ Γ (b.inst v) B) :
   361      InferSem m φ Γ (.letE T v b) B := by
   362    intro ρ hs
   363    obtain ⟨hwv, -⟩ := hv ρ hs
   364    obtain ⟨hwb, hwB, hTB, hmem⟩ := hb ρ hs
   365    refine ⟨?_, hwB, hTB, ?_⟩
   366    · rw [WellDenoted_letE]; exact ⟨hwv, (WellDenoted_inst0 m.M φ hwv).mp hwb⟩
   367    · rw [interp_zeta]; exact hmem

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L369-L385
   369  /-- **What the value checks give**: the value's value is
   370  a member of the type's, so the value extends a satisfying environment
   371  to one satisfying the context extended by the type.  The substitution
   372  version does not need it (`letE_sound`); a version that opens the body
   373  at a let-variable of type `T` would (the body's claim is then stated at
   374  `T :: Γ`).  The type and the value's inferred type are both types,
   375  never the point, so `DefEq`'s conditional claim applies to them. -/
   376  theorem letE_sat {Γ : List Expr} {T v s tv : Expr} {u : Level}
   377      (hT : InferSem m φ Γ T s) (hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (.sort u))
   378      (hv : InferSem m φ Γ v tv) (hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ tv T) {ρ : Nat → V}
   379      (hs : Sat m.M φ Γ ρ) :
   380      Sat m.M φ (T :: Γ) (cons (interp m.M φ ρ v) ρ) := by
   381    obtain ⟨hwT, hmemT⟩ := mem_typeU_of hT hu hs
   382    have hTT := IsTy_of_mem_typeU hmemT
   383    obtain ⟨-, hwtv, hTtv, hmem⟩ := hv ρ hs
   384    rw [hd ρ hs hwtv hwT hTtv.ne_pt hTT.ne_pt] at hmem
   385    exact (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwT, hTT, hmem⟩

    87  theorem refl_sound {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : RedSem m φ Γ e e :=

    90  theorem trans_sound {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr}
    91      (h₁ : RedSem m φ Γ e₁ e₂) (h₂ : RedSem m φ Γ e₂ e₃) : RedSem m φ Γ e₁ e₃ := by
    92    intro ρ hs hw hn
    93    obtain ⟨hw₁, he₁⟩ := h₁ ρ hs hw hn
    94    obtain ⟨hw₂, he₂⟩ := h₂ ρ hs hw₁ (he₁ ▸ hn)
    95    exact ⟨hw₂, he₁.trans he₂⟩

    98      RedSem m φ Γ (.app f a) (.app f' a) := by
    99    intro ρ hs hw hn
   100    rw [WellDenoted_app] at hw
   101    obtain ⟨hf, ha, p, A, B, hslot, hmem, hB, hT⟩ := hw
   102    obtain ⟨hf', he⟩ := h ρ hs hf (fn_ne_pt hn)
   103    refine ⟨?_, by simp [he]⟩
   104    rw [WellDenoted_app]
   105    exact ⟨hf', ha, p, A, B, he ▸ hslot, hmem, hB, hT⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L529-L546
   529  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of the checker's
   530  `isDefEq`.
   531  
   532  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:334-357`).
   533  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   534  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   535  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   536  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   537  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   538  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   539  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   540  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   541  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   542  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  Nor does the
   543  checker chain through an arbitrary middle term: every comparison it
   544  makes is one of the rules below, and its one way to chain is
   545  "reduce, then continue": `redL`.
   546  -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L670-L714
   670  /-- **Lambda telescope congruence, typed at the innermost level only**.
   671  Two lambda telescopes are compared level by level: the domains
   672  at every level, the bodies' types only where the comparison stops
   673  descending through two lambdas.
   674  
   675  *Why the outer levels need no type comparison.*  Syntactically: the
   676  type of `fun x : A => fun y : B => c` is `∀ x : A, ∀ y : B, T` where
   677  `T` is `c`'s type, so for two telescopes compared with equal domains,
   678  each outer level's bodies' types are `∀`s over the domain the next
   679  level compares, with the next level's bodies' types as codomains; equal
   680  innermost bodies' types give equal bodies' types at every level, by
   681  `∀`-congruence.  Semantically (`Sound.lean`, `DefEqLams.outer_sound`):
   682  the type comparison is what makes lambda congruence's claim
   683  **unconditional** — `DefEq`'s claim says nothing where a side is the
   684  point, and two bodies in one type are both the point or neither — and
   685  an unconditional equality of the bodies at every value of the variable
   686  is an equality of the lambdas, with no type at all.  So the claim of this
   687  relation, `LamsSem`, is unconditional, and it propagates outward
   688  through any number of levels.
   689  
   690  *Unequal depth, and reduction between levels.*  The descent continues
   691  only through two **syntactic** lambdas (`outer`'s premise is this relation
   692  itself, which has no reduction rule).  Where one body is not a lambda — the
   693  comparison ends in η, or in any other rule, possibly after δ or whnf
   694  steps — that level is the innermost one (`inner`), and its bodies'
   695  types are inferred and compared at the full grade.  A δ or whnf step
   696  between levels therefore resets the accounting: the δ-witness `d :=
   697  fun x => (fun h => h) n` (`Probe.lean`, `lam_congr_sorts_unsound`)
   698  puts the reduction inside `inner`'s untyped premise `DefEq … b₁ b₂`,
   699  where the type comparison is still required.  Syntactically equal
   700  lambdas (`refl`) are equal outright. -/
   701  inductive DefEqLams (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   702    /-- Syntactically equal sides (the checker's `a == b` fast path). -/
   703    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {a : Expr} : DefEqLams env Γ a a
   704    /-- The innermost level: `DefEq.lam`'s premises — domains, bodies,
   705    and the bodies' inferred types. -/
   706    | inner {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ t₁ t₂ : Expr} :
   707        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂ →
   708        Infer env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ t₁ → Infer env (A₂ :: Γ) b₂ t₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) t₁ t₂ →
   709        DefEqLams env Γ (lam A₁ b₁) (lam A₂ b₂)
   710    /-- An outer level: the domains, and the bodies by this relation —
   711    no inference, no type comparison. -/
   712    | outer {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ : Expr} :
   713        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEqLams env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂ →
   714        DefEqLams env Γ (lam A₁ b₁) (lam A₂ b₂)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L722-L739
   722  /-- **An outer level needs no type**: the bodies are equal
   723  at every value of the variable, unconditionally, so the lambdas are; the
   724  domains are types, never the point, so their conditional claim
   725  applies.  This is why the type comparison is owed only at the
   726  innermost level of a lambda telescope pair. -/
   727  theorem outer_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ : Expr}
   728      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₁ A₂) (hb : LamsSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂) :
   729      LamsSem m φ Γ (.lam A₁ b₁) (.lam A₂ b₂) := by
   730    intro ρ hs h₁ h₂
   731    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at h₁ h₂
   732    have heA := hA ρ hs h₁.1 h₂.1 h₁.2.1.ne_pt h₂.2.1.ne_pt
   733    simp only [interp_lam]
   734    rw [heA]
   735    apply lamV_congr
   736    intro x hx
   737    have hx₁ : x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₁ := by rw [heA]; exact hx
   738    exact hb (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, h₂.1, h₂.2.1, hx⟩) (h₁.2.2.1 x hx₁)
   739      (h₂.2.2.1 x hx)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IOWitness.lean#L444-L456
   444  /-- **Lambda congruence with io-inferred bodies' types is unsound.**  In a
   445  model of `ioEnv` (both definitions typed): the domains by `refl`, the
   446  bodies `g x n` and `n` by δ, β, β and `refl`, both bodies io-infer
   447  `Prop`, `Prop ≡ Prop` by `refl` — every premise of `DefEq.lam` with
   448  `InferIO` in place of `Infer`; the lambdas are well-denoted, not the point,
   449  and different. -/

   454      InferIO ioEnv [.sort .zero] (.const nName []) (.sort .zero) ∧
   455      DefEq ioEnv [.sort .zero] (.sort .zero) (.sort .zero) ∧
   456      ¬ DefEqSem (ioModel (V := V)) φ [] lamG lamConst := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/IOGrade.lean#L60-L95
    60  /-- **The fast-inference grade** (Lean's `infer_only`): the rules of
    61  `Infer` without the application's argument check and without the lambda's
    62  domain check.  `∀`-formation still infers the sorts, which its result
    63  needs. -/
    64  inductive InferIO [LevelOracle] (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    65    /-- A bound variable: its context entry. -/
    66    | bvar {Γ : List Expr} {i : Nat} {A : Expr} :
    67        Γ[i]? = some A → InferIO env Γ (bvar i) (A.liftN (i + 1))
    68    /-- `Sort u : Sort (u + 1)`. -/
    69    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u : Level} : InferIO env Γ (sort u) (sort (.succ u))
    70    /-- A stored constant: its declared type. -/
    71    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} :
    72        env.find? c = some ci → ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
    73        InferIO env Γ (const c ls) (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)
    74    /-- `∀`-formation: the sorts of the domain and the body. -/
    75    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} :
    76        InferIO env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
    77        InferIO env (A :: Γ) B t → Red env (A :: Γ) t (sort v) →
    78        InferIO env Γ (pi A B) (sort (.imax u v))
    79    /-- Lambda: the `∀` of the body's type; the domain is not checked. -/
    80    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A b bt : Expr} :
    81        InferIO env (A :: Γ) b bt → InferIO env Γ (lam A b) (pi A bt)
    82    /-- **Application without a certificate**: the head's type reduces
    83    to a `∀`, and the result is its body at the argument.  The
    84    argument's type is not inferred. -/
    85    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B : Expr} :
    86        InferIO env Γ f tf → Red env Γ tf (pi A B) →
    87        InferIO env Γ (app f a) (B.inst a)
    88    /-- **`let`, by substitution**:
    89    as official `infer_only`, the value is not checked
    90    against the type — the full grade (`Infer.letE`) checks it — and the
    91    body with the value substituted is inferred at the io grade.  The
    92    soundness proof needs no check on the value (`InferIO.letE_sound`). -/
    93    | letE {Γ : List Expr} {T v b B : Expr} :
    94        InferIO env Γ (b.inst v) B →
    95        InferIO env Γ (letE T v b) B

== whitepaper/Fragment/IOGrade.lean#L148-L172
   148  /-- **Membership with the type's invariant.** -/
   149  def IOMem (T : Expr) (ρ : Nat → V) (v : V) : Prop :=
   150    WellDenoted M φ ρ T ∧ IsTy (interp M φ ρ T) ∧ v ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ T
   151  
   152  /-- **The hereditary part**, by recursion on the type's syntax: at a
   153  `∀`, a graph over its domain that is not everywhere the point, whose
   154  applications satisfy the claim at the body.  Nothing at any other
   155  type. -/
   156  def IOHered : Expr → (Nat → V) → V → Prop
   157    | .pi A B, ρ, v =>
   158      WellDenoted M φ ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp M φ ρ A) ∧
   159        (∃ B' : V → V, v ∈ˢ piSet (interp M φ ρ A) B') ∧
   160        (∃ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A ∧ app v x ≠ pt) ∧
   161        ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A →
   162          app v x = pt ∨ IOMem M φ B (cons x ρ) (app v x) ∨ IOHered B (cons x ρ) (app v x)
   163    | .bvar _, _, _ => False
   164    | .sort _, _, _ => False
   165    | .const _ _, _, _ => False
   166    | .app _ _, _, _ => False
   167    | .lam _ _, _, _ => False
   168    | .letE _ _ _, _, _ => False
   169  
   170  /-- **The io claim**: the point, a member, or hereditarily a member. -/
   171  def IORel (T : Expr) (ρ : Nat → V) (v : V) : Prop :=
   172    v = pt ∨ IOMem M φ T ρ v ∨ IOHered M φ T ρ v

== whitepaper/Fragment/IOGrade.lean#L368-L369
   368  theorem inferIO_sound : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr},
   369      InferIO env Γ e T → InferIOSem m φ Γ e T

   428      DefEqSem m φ Γ a b := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Env.lean#L116-L132
   116  /-- **The environment**: the accepted constants, most recent first.  A
   117  name is stored at most once; `find?` reads the first entry. -/
   118  structure Env where

   121    deriving DecidableEq
   122

   126  def find? (env : Env) (n : Name) : Option ConstInfo := env.consts.lookup n
   127

   131  /-- Store one more constant. -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/Env.lean#L66-L107
    66  /-- What kind of constant a name is stored as. -/
    67  inductive ConstKind where
    68    /-- A definition: its value unfolds (δ). -/
    69    | defn (value : Expr)
    70    /-- An inductive type former with `numParams` parameters,
    71    `numIndices` indices and these constructors — and the block's
    72    specification it was generated from (`Spec.lean`), which a later
    73    block nesting through this one reads back (con-leche stores the
    74    block's shape with the former likewise, `IndCaps`). -/
    75    | induct (numParams numIndices : Nat) (ctors : List Name) (spec : IndSpec)
    76    /-- A constructor of the inductive `induct`, with `numParams`
    77    parameters (the inductive's) and `nfields` fields. -/
    78    | ctor (induct : Name) (numParams nfields : Nat)
    79    /-- A recursor with the given telescope shape — `numParams`
    80    parameters, `numMotives` motives, `numMinors` minor premises,
    81    `numIndices` indices, then the major premise — and its rules. -/
    82    | recursor (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat) (rules : List RecRule)
    83    /-- **An assumption**: a constant known by its type alone — a
    84    theorem's statement, or a definition whose value is left out
    85    (`Modular.lean`).  It never unfolds. -/
    86    | assumed
    87    deriving DecidableEq
    88  
    89  namespace ConstKind
    90  
    91  /-- The value a definition unfolds to. -/
    92  def value? : ConstKind → Option Expr
    93    | defn v => some v
    94    | _ => none
    95  
    96  end ConstKind
    97  
    98  /-- A stored constant: its level parameters, its type (closed, over
    99  those parameters) and its kind. -/
   100  structure ConstInfo where
   101    /-- The level parameters. -/
   102    lparams : List Name
   103    /-- The declared type, a closed term over `lparams`. -/
   104    type : Expr
   105    /-- The kind. -/
   106    kind : ConstKind
   107    deriving DecidableEq

   363    firing path reads are stored: `majorIdx` (= numParams + numMotives +
   364    numMinors + numIndices, the major premise's argument position) and
   365    `rulePrefix` (= numParams + numMotives + numMinors, the length of the
   366    argument prefix a rule's rhs is applied to).  The individual counts

   368    | recInfo (val : ConstantVal) (majorIdx rulePrefix : Nat)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Expr.lean#L315-L325
   315  inductive Expr where

   317    | fvar (idx : Nat) (type : Expr)
   318    | sort (u : Level)
   319    | const (n : Name) (us : List Level)
   320    | app (f a : Expr)
   321    | lam (type body : Expr)
   322    | forallE (type body : Expr)
   323    | letE (type value body : Expr)
   324    | lit (l : Literal)
   325    | proj (structName : Name) (idx : Nat) (e : Expr)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Syntax.lean#L112-L121
   112  /-- Instantiate the level parameters `ps` at the levels `ls`, in
   113  sorts and constants. -/
   114  def instL (ps : List Name) (ls : List Level) : Expr → Expr
   115    | bvar i => bvar i
   116    | sort u => sort (u.subst ps ls)
   117    | const c us => const c (us.map (Level.subst ps ls))
   118    | app f a => app (instL ps ls f) (instL ps ls a)
   119    | lam A b => lam (instL ps ls A) (instL ps ls b)
   120    | pi A B => pi (instL ps ls A) (instL ps ls B)
   121    | letE T v b => letE (instL ps ls T) (instL ps ls v) (instL ps ls b)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L218-L231
   218  def Expr.instantiateLevelParams (ks : List Name) (us : List Level) : Expr → Expr
   219    | .bvar i => .bvar i
   220    | .fvar idx ty => .fvar idx (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   221    | .sort u => .sort (Level.subst ks us u)
   222    | .const n vs => .const n (vs.map (Level.subst ks us))
   223    | .app f a => .app (f.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (a.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   224    | .lam ty body =>
   225      .lam (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   226    | .forallE ty body =>
   227      .forallE (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   228    | .letE ty val body => .letE (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   229        (val.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   230    | .lit l => .lit l
   231    | .proj s i e => .proj s i (e.instantiateLevelParams ks us)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L592-L606
   592  /-- **A definition is accepted** (con-leche's `checkDefnVal`): the
   593  name is fresh, the declared type's type reduces to a sort, the
   594  value's inferred type is definitionally equal to the declared type,
   595  and both terms use only the declared level parameters.  That is the
   596  one scope condition the typing derivations do not give (the sort rule
   597  accepts `Sort u` at any level `u`); closedness and stored constants
   598  they do give (`Infer.closedAt`, `Infer.consts`,
   599  `ScopeOfInfer.lean`), so the environment section recovers the full
   600  scope of both terms (`DefOk.type_scoped`, `DefOk.value_scoped`). -/
   601  def DefOk (env : Env) (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) : Prop :=
   602    env.find? c = none ∧
   603    (∃ s u, Infer env [] ci.type s ∧ Red env [] s (.sort u)) ∧
   604    (∃ v T, ci.kind = .defn v ∧ Infer env [] v T ∧ DefEq env [] T ci.type ∧
   605      v.lparamsIn ci.lparams = true) ∧
   606    ci.type.lparamsIn ci.lparams = true

== ConLeche/Kernel/CheckerBase.lean#L105-L121
   105  def checkConstantVal (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (cv : ConstantVal) : m Unit := do
   106    if (env.find? cv.name).isSome then
   107      throw (.invalid s!"duplicate declaration {cv.name}")
   108    if reservedBasisNames.contains cv.name then
   109      throw (.invalid s!"reserved basis name {cv.name}")
   110    unless Name.nodup cv.levelParams do
   111      throw (.invalid s!"duplicate universe parameters in {cv.name}")
   112    unless cv.type.looseBVarsBounded 0 do
   113      throw (.invalid s!"loose bound variable in type of {cv.name}")
   114    if cv.type.hasFvar then
   115      throw (.invalid s!"unexpected free variable in type of {cv.name}")
   116    unless cv.type.allLevelParamsDefined cv.levelParams do
   117      throw (.invalid s!"undeclared universe parameter in type of {cv.name}")
   118    unless cv.type.constsResolve env do
   119      throw (unresolvedConstsErrorL (strLitSupported env) s!"type of {cv.name}" cv.type)
   120    let stype ← ops.inferType env 0 cv.type
   121    let _u ← ops.ensureSort env 0 stype

== ConLeche/Kernel/Checker.lean#L34-L47
    34  def checkDefnVal (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (cv : ConstantVal)
    35      (value : Expr) (hint : ReducibilityHint) : m Env := do
    36    unless value.looseBVarsBounded 0 do
    37      throw (.invalid s!"loose bound variable in value of {cv.name}")
    38    if value.hasFvar then
    39      throw (.invalid s!"unexpected free variable in value of {cv.name}")
    40    unless value.allLevelParamsDefined cv.levelParams do
    41      throw (.invalid s!"undeclared universe parameter in value of {cv.name}")
    42    unless value.constsResolve env do
    43      throw (unresolvedConstsErrorL (strLitSupported env) s!"value of {cv.name}" value)
    44    let vtype ← ops.inferType env 0 value
    45    unless ← ops.isDefEq env 0 vtype cv.type do
    46      throw (.invalid s!"type mismatch in definition {cv.name}")
    47    pure ⟨.defnInfo cv value hint :: env.consts, env.tables⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/EnvModel.lean#L298-L362
   298  /-- **A model of an environment**: the assignment and the laws. -/
   299  structure EnvModel (V : Type u) [SetLib V] (env : Env) where
   300    /-- The set of every constant at every list of concrete levels. -/
   301    M : Name → List Nat → V
   302    /-- Every stored constant's type, instantiated, is well-denoted and a
   303    type, and the constant is a member of it — at every valuation and every
   304    environment (the types are closed, so `ρ` is irrelevant, and stating
   305    it for all `ρ` saves a closedness lemma). -/
   306    type_ok : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo), env.find? c = some ci →
   307      ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (ls : List Level), ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   308        WellDenoted M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   309        IsTy (interp M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)) ∧
   310        M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ)) ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)
   311    /-- A definition's value, instantiated, is well-denoted and denotes
   312    the constant. -/
   313    unfold : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (v : Expr), env.find? c = some ci →
   314      ci.value? = some v →
   315      ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (ls : List Level), ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   316        WellDenoted M φ ρ (v.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   317        interp M φ ρ (v.instL ci.lparams ls) = M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ))
   318    /-- Every plain rule of every stored recursor satisfies its ι law. -/
   319    rec_rules : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   320      (rules : List RecRule),
   321      env.find? c = some ci →
   322      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   323      ∀ rl ∈ rules, rl.inst = none → ∀ cij : ConstInfo, env.find? rl.ctor = some cij →
   324        RecRuleLaw M c ci numParams (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   325          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl cij
   326    /-- Every nested rule of every stored recursor satisfies its ι law,
   327    at its constructor's own parameter count. -/
   328    rec_rules_nested : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   329      (rules : List RecRule),
   330      env.find? c = some ci →
   331      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   332      ∀ rl ∈ rules, ∀ (lvs : List Level) (pinst : List Expr), rl.inst = some (lvs, pinst) →
   333        ∀ (cij : ConstInfo) (I : Name) (nPc nf : Nat), env.find? rl.ctor = some cij →
   334          cij.kind = .ctor I nPc nf →
   335          RecRuleLawN M c ci nPc (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   336            (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl cij
   337    /-- Every stored inductive family's fibres are truth values where its
   338    stored sort evaluates to zero and strict where it does not.
   339    No guard is needed: the stage of an installation that gives the
   340    former an arbitrary family (`mIndF`) takes it in the universe and
   341    admissible, which is strict above a proposition. -/
   342    ind_fib : ∀ (I : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (nP nI : Nat) (ctors : List Name) (S : IndSpec),
   343      env.find? I = some ci → ci.kind = .induct nP nI ctors S → IndFibLaw M I ci nP nI S
   344    /-- Every rule of every stored recursor satisfies the slot law:
   345    where the major is the point, the recursor's application or
   346    the rule's constructor is. -/
   347    rec_rules_slot : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   348      (rules : List RecRule),
   349      env.find? c = some ci →
   350      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   351      ∀ rl ∈ rules, ∀ cij : ConstInfo, env.find? rl.ctor = some cij →
   352        RecRuleSlotLaw M c ci (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl cij
   353    /-- Every rule flagged K of every stored recursor satisfies the K law:
   354    inversion of the least fixed point plus the plain law
   355    at the recursor's own parameters (`IndSpec.rec_rule_lawK`). -/
   356    rec_rules_k : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   357      (rules : List RecRule),
   358      env.find? c = some ci →
   359      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   360      ∀ rl ∈ rules, rl.k = true →
   361        RecRuleLawK M c ci (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   362          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl

   229  structure EnvModelM (μ : CheckMode) (env : Env) where
   230    /-- the environment carrier, contained -/
   231    base2 : EnvModel V env

   233    type_reads : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ ψ : Name → Nat,

== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L80-L103
    80  /-- **The data of a single inductive block** without its class

   100    large : Bool

   102    elim : Name

== whitepaper/Fragment/Spec.lean#L28-L42
    28  /-- A constructor field, as the positivity check classifies it
    29  (con-leche's `RecFieldKind`, `FieldTele.lean:29`).  Its domain is an
    30  expression under the parameters and the earlier fields. -/
    31  inductive Field where
    32    /-- An ordinary field: any domain that does not mention the block. -/
    33    | ordinary (A : Expr)
    34    /-- A reflexive field: `∀ tele, I params es` — a function space into
    35    the family at the block's parameters and the index expressions `es`;
    36    `tele` is a context (innermost first) under the parameters and the
    37    earlier fields, `es` a spine (outermost first) under `tele` too.
    38    With an empty telescope the field is simply **recursive**: the
    39    family itself (`reflexive [] es`) — one kind covers both, as the
    40    generated terms and the model treat them alike.  (Con-leche keeps
    41    them apart: `RecFieldKind.recursive`/`.reflexive`, `FieldTele.lean`.) -/
    42    | reflexive (tele : List Expr) (es : List Expr)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean#L598-L608
   598  /-- The field's kind as the run found it: hole-free, a member hole
   599  (finitary or under `Π` binders), an instantiation IN PROGRESS (a `Y`
   600  hole — only inside a container's constructors), or an accepted
   601  instantiation (under `Π` binders when `refl`). -/
   602  inductive NestFieldKind where
   603    | ordinary
   604    | recursive (tgt : Nat)
   605    | reflexive (tgt : Nat)
   606    | inProgress
   607    | nested (refl : Bool)
   608    deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L641-L655
   641  /-- The scope of a field's pieces: with `k` earlier fields, an
   642  ordinary domain is in scope under the parameters and them; a
   643  reflexive field's telescope entries under the earlier telescope
   644  entries as well, and its index expressions under the whole telescope
   645  (under the parameters and the earlier fields alone when the telescope
   646  is empty); a reflexive field's index expressions are as many as the
   647  indices.  No piece
   648  mentions the block (it is not stored in `env`): that is **strict
   649  positivity** in the shape the fragment admits (con-leche's
   650  `nestPos`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/Positivity.lean:1453`). -/
   651  def fieldScoped (env : Env) (k : Nat) : Field → Prop
   652    | .ordinary A => Expr.Scoped env S.lparams (S.nP + k) A
   653    | .reflexive tele es =>
   654      (∀ t T, tele[t]? = some T → Expr.Scoped env S.lparams (S.nP + k + (tele.length - 1 - t)) T) ∧
   655      es.length = S.nI ∧ (∀ e ∈ es, Expr.Scoped env S.lparams (S.nP + k + tele.length) e)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L385-L399
   385  def classRecTyOk (ops : CheckerOps m) (fe : FEnv) (g : ClassGen) (k : Nat) (rc : RecShape)
   386      (cvRi : ConstantVal) (c : Nat) : m ConstantVal := do
   387    let ci := g.cls.getD c default
   388    unless rc.tgt == ci.member.getD k do
   389      throw (.invalid "generated recursor: the recursor record's member is not its class's")
   390    unless rc.rP == g.nP + g.slots.length && rc.mI == rc.rP + ci.nIdx do
   391      throw (.invalid "generated recursor: the recursor record's rule prefix or major index is \
   392        not the generated one")
   393    let gty ← unwrapOr (classGenRecTy g c) (.internal "generated recursor: recursor type")
   394    let cvG := { rc.cvR with type := gty }
   395    classConstOk ops fe cvG
   396    unless ← ops.isDefEq fe.env 0 cvRi.type cvG.type do
   397      throw (.invalid s!"generated recursor: the type of {rc.cvR.name} is not the generated one \
   398        (official: invalid recursor)")
   399    pure cvG

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/ClassRead.lean#L24-L32
    24  This file READS that data off the recursor types, syntactically, and
    25  checks nothing.  Everything it returns is re-established by the stage:
    26  every class is checked like a major (`targetMajorOf`), the inductive
    27  hypotheses read here must be exactly the positivity check's recursive
    28  fields, and every recursor TYPE is generated from the classes and the
    29  positivity check's recorded constructors and compared by `isDefEq` with
    30  the stream's.  What the stage installs is the generated family, never
    31  anything read here: a wrong reading can only make the generated type

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L232-L244
   232  /-- **An inductive hypothesis' type** for the field with `k` earlier
   233  fields, `l` earlier hypotheses, `o` binders between the parameters
   234  and the fields (the motive sits `nF + l + o - 1` binders above):
   235  `∀ tele, motive es (f tele)` at a reflexive field (`motive es f` when
   236  the telescope is empty). -/
   237  def ihTy (nF k l o : Nat) : Field → Expr
   238    | .ordinary _ => .sort .zero
   239    | .reflexive tele es =>
   240      let m := tele.length
   241      mkPis (liftCtx (fun t T => atCtx nF k l o t T) tele)
   242        (mkAppN (.bvar (nF + l + o - 1 + m))
   243          (es.map (atCtx nF k l o m) ++ [mkAppN (.bvar (nF - 1 - k + l + m)) (varsAt 0 m)]))
   244    | .container => mkAppN (.bvar (nF + l + o - 2)) [.bvar (nF - 1 - k + l)]

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L175-L182
   175  /-- **The generated recursor type** at class `c`. -/
   176  def classGenRecTy (g : ClassGen) (c : Nat) : Option Expr := do
   177    let pre := g.pre
   178    let rP := pre.length
   179    let (ifs, maj) ← g.major c rP

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L188-L207
   188  def classGenRule (g : ClassGen) (recOf : Nat → Option Name) (rlvls : List Level) (c : Nat)
   189      (x : ClassCtor) : Option Expr := do
   190    let pre := g.pre
   191    let rP := pre.length
   192    let (s, _) ← (List.range g.slots.length).zip g.slots |>.find? fun (_, sl) =>
   193      match sl with | .minor c' C _ => c' == c && C == x.cv.name | _ => false
   194    let (fvs, _) ← openPisAtFvars x.nF x.tyD rP
   195    let ws ← targetPiDomsWith fvs x.tyN
   196    let pvars := (List.range rP).map fun i => if i < g.nP then g.params.getD i default else
   197      g.slotVar (i - g.nP)
   198    let ihs ← (List.range x.nF).filterMapM fun i =>
   199      match x.kinds.getD i .ordinary with
   200      | .ordinary => some none
   201      | .recursive t tele => do
   202        let f := fvs.getD i default
   203        let (xs, idx) ← g.ihParts t tele (ws.getD i default) (rP + x.nF)
   204        let r ← recOf t
   205        pure (some (closeLams (xs.map g.binder) (rP + x.nF)
   206          (Expr.mkAppN (.const r rlvls) (pvars ++ idx ++ [Expr.mkAppN f xs]))))
   207    pure (closeLams (pre ++ fvs.map g.binder) 0 (Expr.mkAppN (g.slotVar s) (fvs ++ ihs)))

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L723-L730
   723  /-- **The subsingleton criterion** for a field of sort `v` at
   724  position `i` (innermost first) of a constructor with index
   725  expressions `idx`: the field is a proposition, or it is one of the
   726  result's indices (official's `elim_only_at_universe_zero` at one
   727  constructor; con-leche's `checkStructFieldSortsI`).  Required only of a
   728  large eliminator on a block whose sort may be `Prop`. -/
   729  def SubsingletonField (v : Level) (i : Nat) (idx : List Expr) : Prop :=
   730    S.large = true → ¬ S.NeverProp → (LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true ∨ Expr.bvar i ∈ idx)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L719-L721
   719  /-- "The result sort is never `Prop`": `1 ≤ u` at every valuation
   720  (con-leche's `Level.isNeverZero`). -/
   721  def NeverProp : Prop := LevelOracle.le (.succ .zero) S.sort = true

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockRec.lean#L82-L84
    82  def blockLargeElimAllowed (p : BlockShape) (nested : Bool) : Bool :=
    83    p.resSort.isNeverZero ||
    84      (p.large && p.k == 1 && !nested && (p.numCtors == 0 || p.numCtors == 1))

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/SumInstall.lean#L85-L99
    85  def checkStructFieldSortsI (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (isProp large : Bool)
    86      (s : Level) (nP : Nat) (fvs idxArgs : List Expr) : Nat → m (List Level)
    87    | 0 => pure []
    88    | j + 1 => do
    89      let fv ← unwrapOr fvs[j]? (.internal "direct sum: field index")
    90      let ty ← ops.inferType env (nP + j) fv.fvarTypeD
    91      let u ← ops.ensureSort env (nP + j) ty
    92      if !isProp then
    93        unless ← liftFueled "level comparison" (Level.leq u s) do
    94          throw (.invalid "direct sum: field universe too large")
    95      else if large then
    96        unless Level.isEquiv u .zero == some true || idxArgs.contains fv do
    97          throw (.invalid "direct sum: large eliminator with a non-propositional \
    98            field outside the indices")
    99      let rest ← checkStructFieldSortsI ops env isProp large s nP fvs idxArgs j

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L712-L717
   712  /-- The universe bound on a field of sort `v`: the family is a
   713  proposition, or `v ≤ u` (official's "universe level of `type_of(arg)`
   714  is too big" check, `checkStructFieldSortsI`,
   715  `ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/SumInstall.lean:124`). -/
   716  def FieldBound (v : Level) : Prop :=
   717    LevelOracle.eq S.sort .zero = true ∨ LevelOracle.le v S.sort = true

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L732-L777
   732  /-- **The block is accepted** (con-leche's `checkBlock`,
   733  `ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockTail.lean:143`):
   734  
   735  * the block's names are distinct and fresh;
   736  * the specification is in scope (closed, stored constants, declared
   737    level parameters — positivity included);
   738  * the generated type former's type has a sort in the current
   739    environment;
   740  * each generated constructor's type has a sort in the environment
   741    holding the former, every field's domain has a sort respecting the
   742    universe bound and, where a large eliminator asks it, the
   743    subsingleton criterion, and so does every binder of a reflexive
   744    field's telescope (the domain's sort implies it; the fragment lists
   745    it, as the checker infers it);
   746  * each rule's type (`ruleType`, the recursor's binder prefix with the
   747    constructor's fields in place of the indices and the major) has a
   748    sort in the environment holding the former and the constructors;
   749  * a large eliminator on a block whose sort may be `Prop` has at most
   750    one constructor (official's `elim_only_at_universe_zero`);
   751  * the generated recursor's type has a sort in the environment holding
   752    the former and the constructors.
   753  
   754  The recursor's rules are generated and stored, not checked: they
   755  mention the recursor.  Con-leche does type its generated rules, in
   756  the environment holding the recursors without their rules
   757  (`classRuleOk`, `GenRec.lean:427`); the fragment stores them as is. -/
   758  def Ok (env : Env) : Prop :=
   759    (S.name :: S.recName :: S.ctors.map (·.name)).Nodup ∧
   760    (∀ m ∈ S.name :: S.recName :: S.ctors.map (·.name), env.find? m = none) ∧
   761    S.Scoped env ∧
   762    (∃ T, Infer env [] S.indType T) ∧
   763    (∀ c ∈ S.ctors,
   764      (∃ T u, Infer (S.envInd env) [] (S.ctorType c) T ∧ Red (S.envInd env) [] T (.sort u)) ∧
   765      (∀ i A, (S.fieldCtx c.fields)[i]? = some A →
   766        ∃ s v, Infer (S.envInd env) ((S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) A s ∧
   767          Red (S.envInd env) ((S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) s (.sort v) ∧
   768          S.FieldBound v ∧ S.SubsingletonField v i c.idx) ∧
   769      (∀ i tele es, c.fields[i]? = some (.reflexive tele es) → ∀ t T, tele[t]? = some T →
   770        ∃ s w, Infer (S.envInd env)
   771            (tele.drop (t + 1) ++ (S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params) T s ∧
   772          Red (S.envInd env) (tele.drop (t + 1) ++ (S.fieldCtx c.fields).drop (i + 1) ++ S.params)
   773            s (.sort w) ∧
   774          S.FieldBound w) ∧
   775      (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] (S.ruleType c) T)) ∧
   776    (S.large = true → ¬ S.NeverProp → S.ctors.length ≤ 1) ∧
   777    (∃ T, Infer (S.envCtors env) [] S.recType T)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/BlockTail.lean#L141-L146
   141  def checkBlock (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) (block : List ConstantInfo) (p₀ : BlockParts) :
   142      m Env := do
   143    unless (p₀.allCtors.map (·.1.name)).Nodup ∧ p₀.memberNames.Nodup do
   144      throw (.invalid "direct rec: duplicate constructor")
   145    let q ← checkBlockPass ops env p₀ (blockRawRec p₀)
   146    checkBlockTail ops block q

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L308-L313
   308  /-- **A rule's type**: `∀ params motive minors fields, motive idx (C params fields)`
   309  — the recursor's binder prefix with the constructor's fields in place
   310  of the indices and the major (con-leche generates the rule and
   311  type-checks it, `classRuleOk`, `GenRec.lean:427`; the stream's rules
   312  are never read; the fragment infers the rule's type likewise). -/
   313  def ruleType (c : CtorSpec) : Expr := mkPis (S.ruleCtx c) (S.ruleBodyTy c)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Inductives/GenRec.lean#L412-L433
   412  /-- **One generated rule, installed** (as generated): resolved and typed
   413  at the rule-less recursors' environment `feR` (its level parameters the
   414  recursor's), its λ-telescope over the prefix and the fields `n` long,
   415  its λ-domains resolving at the constructors' environment `feT`.
   416  Returns the rule (stored). -/
   417  def classRuleOk (ops : CheckerOps m) (w : StructWalkers) (feT feR : FEnv) (cvR : ConstantVal)
   418      (n : Nat) (gen : Expr) : m Expr := do
   419    unless gen.looseBVarsBounded 0 && !gen.hasFvar do
   420      throw (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} is not closed")
   421    let genA := gen
   422    unless genA.allLevelParamsDefined cvR.levelParams do
   423      throw (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} names an undeclared universe \
   424        parameter")
   425    unless w.resolve feR genA do
   426      throw (unresolvedConstsError s!"generated rule of {cvR.name}" genA)
   427    let _ ← ops.inferType feR.env 0 genA
   428    let (rbs, _) ← unwrapOr (genA.stripLams n)
   429      (.internal s!"generated recursor: a rule of {cvR.name} is not a λ-telescope over the \
   430        recursor's prefix and the constructor's fields")
   431    unless rbs.all (fun b => w.resolve feT b) do
   432      throw (unresolvedConstsError s!"the domains of a generated rule of {cvR.name}" genA)
   433    pure genA

== whitepaper/Fragment/Decl.lean#L532-L573
   532  /-! ### What is stored -/
   533  
   534  /-- The type former's constant. -/
   535  def indInfo : ConstInfo := ⟨S.lparams, S.indType, .induct S.nP S.nI (S.ctors.map (·.name)) S⟩
   536  
   537  /-- A constructor's constant. -/
   538  def ctorInfo (c : CtorSpec) : ConstInfo :=
   539    ⟨S.lparams, S.ctorType c, .ctor S.name S.nP c.fields.length⟩
   540  
   541  /-- The recursor's constant: `nP` parameters, one motive, `n` minors,
   542  `nI` indices, the generated rules. -/
   543  def recInfo : ConstInfo := ⟨S.recLparams, S.recType, .recursor S.nP 1 S.n S.nI S.rules⟩
   544  
   545  /-- The environment with the type former added. -/
   546  def envInd (env : Env) : Env := env.add S.name S.indInfo
   547  
   548  /-- The environment with the type former and the constructors added,
   549  in order. -/
   550  def envCtors (env : Env) : Env :=
   551    S.ctors.foldl (fun e c => e.add c.name (S.ctorInfo c)) (S.envInd env)
   552  
   553  /-- `T.rec`'s constant in a nested block: `nP` parameters, two
   554  motives, `n + nK` minors, `nI` indices. -/
   555  def recInfoN (N : NestInfo) : ConstInfo :=
   556    ⟨S.recLparams, S.recTypeN N, .recursor S.nP 2 (S.n + N.nK) S.nI (S.rulesN N)⟩
   557  
   558  /-- `T.rec_1`'s constant: the same prefix, no indices. -/
   559  def rec1Info (N : NestInfo) : ConstInfo :=
   560    ⟨S.recLparams, S.rec1Type N, .recursor S.nP 2 (S.n + N.nK) 0 (S.rules1 N)⟩
   561  
   562  /-- **The installed nested block**: former, constructors, the two
   563  recursors. -/
   564  def installN (N : NestInfo) (env : Env) : Env :=
   565    ((S.envCtors env).add S.recName (S.recInfoN N)).add N.aux (S.rec1Info N)
   566  
   567  /-- **The installed block**: former, constructors, recursor — and the
   568  auxiliary recursor for a nested block. -/
   569  def install (env : Env) : Env :=
   570    match S.nest with
   571    | none => (S.envCtors env).add S.recName S.recInfo
   572    | some N => S.installN N env
   573

== whitepaper/Fragment/Env.lean#L56-L63
    56    /-- **The K flag** (Lean's `RecursorVal.k`): the rule

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L43-L88
    43  /-- **The positive universes are Grothendieck universes.**  `SetLib`
    44  with pairing, union, power set and replacement (the image of a set
    45  under any function of the ambient logic), the numerals and `ω`, and
    46  the laws: every `univ n` with `n ≠ 0` is transitive and closed under
    47  the four operations, and contains `ω`. -/
    48  class UnivLib (V : Type u) extends SetLib V where
    49    /-- The unordered pair. -/
    50    upair : V → V → V
    51    /-- The members of a pair. -/
    52    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
    53    /-- The union of the members. -/
    54    sUnion : V → V
    55    /-- The members of a union. -/
    56    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
    57    /-- The power set. -/
    58    power : V → V
    59    /-- The members of a power set: the subsets. -/
    60    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
    61    /-- Replacement: the image of a set under a function. -/
    62    image : (V → V) → V → V
    63    /-- The members of an image. -/
    64    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {A z : V}, Mem z (image f A) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w A ∧ z = f w
    65    /-- The numerals. -/
    66    nat : Nat → V
    67    /-- Distinct numbers have distinct numerals. -/
    68    nat_inj : ∀ {k l : Nat}, nat k = nat l → k = l
    69    /-- `ω`: the set of numerals. -/
    70    omega : V
    71    /-- The members of `ω`. -/
    72    mem_omega : ∀ {z : V}, Mem z omega ↔ ∃ k, z = nat k
    73    /-- A positive universe is transitive: a member of a member is a
    74    member. -/
    75    univ_trans : ∀ {n : Nat} {A x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem A (univ n) → Mem x A → Mem x (univ n)
    76    /-- A positive universe is closed under pairing. -/
    77    upair_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : V}, n ≠ 0 →
    78      Mem a (univ n) → Mem b (univ n) → Mem (upair a b) (univ n)
    79    /-- A positive universe is closed under union. -/
    80    sUnion_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem x (univ n) → Mem (sUnion x) (univ n)
    81    /-- A positive universe is closed under power set. -/
    82    power_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem x (univ n) → Mem (power x) (univ n)
    83    /-- A positive universe is closed under replacement: the image of a
    84    member under a function into the universe is a member. -/
    85    image_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {f : V → V} {A : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem A (univ n) →
    86      (∀ a, Mem a A → Mem (f a) (univ n)) → Mem (image f A) (univ n)
    87    /-- A positive universe contains `ω`. -/
    88    omega_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat}, n ≠ 0 → Mem omega (univ n)

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndLib.lean#L47-L64
    47  /-- **The library for inductive types**: the universes with tuples and
    48  tags. -/
    49  class IndLib (V : Type u) extends UnivLib V where
    50    /-- The n-ary tuple of a list of sets. -/
    51    tuple : List V → V
    52    /-- Tuples are injective. -/
    53    tuple_inj : ∀ {xs ys : List V}, tuple xs = tuple ys → xs = ys
    54    /-- A tuple of members of a positive universe is a member of it. -/
    55    tuple_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {xs : List V}, n ≠ 0 →
    56      (∀ x ∈ xs, Mem x (univ n)) → Mem (tuple xs) (univ n)
    57    /-- A value tagged with a number. -/
    58    tag : Nat → V → V
    59    /-- Tags are injective. -/
    60    tag_inj : ∀ {i j : Nat} {x y : V}, tag i x = tag j y → i = j ∧ x = y
    61    /-- A tagged member of a positive universe is a member of it. -/
    62    tag_mem_univ : ∀ {n i : Nat} {x : V}, n ≠ 0 → Mem x (univ n) → Mem (tag i x) (univ n)
    63    /-- A tagged value is never the point. -/
    64    tag_ne_pt : ∀ {i : Nat} {x : V}, tag i x ≠ pt

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L177-L194
   177  /-- **The union of an indexed family** `⋃ a ∈ A, F a`: replacement,
   178  then union.  Con-leche: `IsTGUniverse.famUnion_mem`,
   179  `ConLeche/SetTheory/Derive/Universe.lean`. -/
   180  def famUnion (A : V) (F : V → V) : V := sUnion (image F A)
   181  
   182  theorem mem_famUnion {A z : V} {F : V → V} : z ∈ˢ famUnion A F ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ˢ A ∧ z ∈ˢ F a := by
   183    unfold famUnion
   184    rw [mem_sUnion]
   185    constructor
   186    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hz⟩
   187      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
   188      exact ⟨a, ha, hz⟩
   189    · rintro ⟨a, ha, hz⟩
   190      exact ⟨F a, mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hz⟩
   191  
   192  theorem famUnion_mem_univ {n : Nat} {A : V} {F : V → V} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hA : A ∈ˢ univ n)
   193      (hF : ∀ a, a ∈ˢ A → F a ∈ˢ univ n) : famUnion A F ∈ˢ (univ n : V) :=
   194    sUnion_mem_univ hn (image_mem_univ hn hA hF)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L212-L231
   212  /-- **The countable union** `F 0 ∪ F 1 ∪ …`: the union over `ω`, each
   213  numeral read back as its number.  Con-leche: `Tower.natUnion`,
   214  `ConLeche/SetModel/Iter.lean`. -/
   215  noncomputable def natUnion (F : Nat → V) : V := famUnion omega fun z => F (idx z)
   216  
   217  theorem mem_natUnion {F : Nat → V} {z : V} : z ∈ˢ natUnion F ↔ ∃ k, z ∈ˢ F k := by
   218    unfold natUnion
   219    rw [mem_famUnion]
   220    constructor
   221    · rintro ⟨w, -, hz⟩
   222      exact ⟨idx w, hz⟩
   223    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
   224      exact ⟨nat k, mem_omega.mpr ⟨k, rfl⟩, by rw [idx_nat]; exact hk⟩
   225  
   226  /-- A countable union of members of a positive universe is a member —
   227  the one use of `ω`.  Con-leche: `Tower.natUnion_mem_univ_pos`,
   228  `ConLeche/SetModel/Iter.lean`. -/
   229  theorem natUnion_mem_univ {n : Nat} {F : Nat → V} (hn : n ≠ 0) (h : ∀ k, F k ∈ˢ univ n) :
   230      natUnion F ∈ˢ (univ n : V) :=
   231    famUnion_mem_univ hn (omega_mem_univ hn) fun _ _ => h _

== whitepaper/Fragment/Univ.lean#L29-L35
    29  **Infinity is not a convenience.**  `V_ω`, the hereditarily finite
    30  sets, is transitive and closed under pairing, union, power set and
    31  replacement, and the least fixed point of `X ↦ {∅} ∪ {x ∪ {x} | x ∈ X}`
    32  — accessible with a one-element bound — is `ω ∉ V_ω`.  So the theorem
    33  `closed_of_acc` (`Access.lean`) needs `ω ∈ univ n`, and uses it
    34  exactly once: the set of finite paths over the bound is a countable
    35  union (`natUnion`).

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L89-L93
    89  def IsTGUniverse {V : Type u} (mem : V → V → Prop) (u : V) : Prop :=
    90    (∀ y z, mem y u → mem z y → mem z u) ∧
    91    (∀ y z, mem y u → (∀ w, mem w z → mem w y) → mem z u) ∧
    92    (∀ y, mem y u → ∃ p, mem p u ∧ ∀ z, (∀ w, mem w z → mem w y) → mem z p) ∧
    93    (∀ y, (∀ w, mem w y → mem w u) → Equinumerous mem y u ∨ mem y u)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L100
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L282-L303
   282  /-- **The set a field ranges over**, relative to a family `W` (index
   283  values to sets), at parameters `ps` and the earlier field values `fs`
   284  (innermost first): an ordinary field's domain; for a reflexive field
   285  the function space over its telescope into the fibres of `W` at the field's
   286  index expressions read under the telescope's values — the fibre
   287  itself when the telescope is empty; for a container field the class
   288  at the fibre of `W` at the nested occurrence's index expressions
   289  (`classSet`: the container's family, read at the class's arguments
   290  with that fibre in the nested position; a plain block has no
   291  container field, and the clause is empty).  Con-leche: a field's
   292  reading with holes, `LfpDatum.fields`, read at the hole frame of the
   293  tuple (`HFits`, `BlockLfp.lean`); the container clause `contApp`
   294  through the container's lfp clause (`BlockLfpMono.lean`). -/
   295  noncomputable def fieldSet (W : List V → V) (ps fs : List V) : Field → V
   296    | .ordinary A => interp M (S.ψ ls) (consList fs (envP ps)) A
   297    | .reflexive tele es =>
   298      piCtx M (S.ψ ls) (consList fs (envP ps)) tele fun ρ' => S.reflBody ls tele (W (S.idxVals M ls ρ' es))
   299    | .container =>
   300      match S.nest with
   301      | some N => S.classSet M ls N ps (W (S.memberIdx M ls N ps))
   302      | none => empty
   303  

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L315-L320
   315  first) relative to a family: each value a member of its field's set
   316  at the earlier values.  Con-leche: `SpineFit` at the hole frame. -/
   317  def FitsFields (W : List V → V) (ps : List V) : List Field → List V → Prop
   318    | [], [] => True
   319    | f :: fs, v :: vs => FitsFields W ps fs vs ∧ v ∈ˢ S.fieldSet M ls W ps vs f
   320    | _, _ => False

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndCommon.lean#L188-L195
   188  /-- **The admissible part of a set**: at a proposition the set itself;
   189  above it the members that are neither the point nor a member of it —
   190  a strict set (`adm_mem_typeU`), so a member of the nested parameter's
   191  domain `Sort u`, a set of types, and the set itself on a
   192  set of tagged values (`adm_eq_self`), such as a fibre of the family.
   193  The class reads the container's set at admissible sets only: there it
   194  is a graph applied inside its domain. -/
   195  def adm (X : V) : V := if S.z ls then X else sep X fun x => x ≠ pt ∧ ¬ x ∈ˢ pt

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndCommon.lean#L278-L286
   278  /-- **The body of a reflexive field's function space**: the family's fibre —
   279  its admissible part under at least one binder.  The
   280  function space is read by values (`SetLib.piV`), and over an arbitrary family
   281  in the universe a fibre `{pt}` would put a Type-sorted field's function space
   282  in the propositional regime; the admissible part, a strict set above a
   283  proposition, keeps it a function space wherever its domain is
   284  inhabited, so the field's set grows with the family (`piCtx_retype`).
   285  On the block's own family the fibres are admissible already. -/
   286  def reflBody (tele : List Expr) (X : V) : V := if tele = [] then X else S.adm ls X

== whitepaper/Fragment/IndSem.lean#L501-L550
   501  replacement and union along the fields (innermost first).
   502  Con-leche builds the fibre the same way, by replacement over the
   503  spines (`BlockLfp.lean`, `fibre`). -/
   504  noncomputable def fitsSet (W : List V → V) (ps : List V) : List Field → V
   505    | [] => sing (tuple [])
   506    | f :: fs => famUnion (fitsSet W ps fs) fun t =>
   507        famUnion (S.fieldSet M ls W ps (untuple t) f) fun v => sing (tuple (v :: untuple t))
   508  
   509  theorem mem_fitsSet {W : List V → V} {ps : List V} :
   510      ∀ {fields : List Field} {x : V},
   511        x ∈ˢ S.fitsSet M ls W ps fields ↔ ∃ fs, S.FitsFields M ls W ps fields fs ∧ x = tuple fs
   512    | [], x => by
   513      simp only [fitsSet, mem_sing]
   514      constructor
   515      · rintro rfl; exact ⟨[], trivial, rfl⟩
   516      · rintro ⟨fs, hfs, rfl⟩
   517        cases fs with
   518        | nil => rfl
   519        | cons _ _ => exact hfs.elim
   520    | f :: fields, x => by
   521      simp only [fitsSet, mem_famUnion, mem_sing]
   522      constructor
   523      · rintro ⟨t, ht, v, hv, rfl⟩
   524        obtain ⟨fs, hfs, rfl⟩ := mem_fitsSet.mp ht
   525        rw [untuple_tuple] at hv ⊢
   526        exact ⟨v :: fs, ⟨hfs, hv⟩, rfl⟩
   527      · rintro ⟨fs, hfs, rfl⟩
   528        cases fs with
   529        | nil => exact hfs.elim
   530        | cons v fs =>
   531          refine ⟨tuple fs, mem_fitsSet.mpr ⟨fs, hfs.1, rfl⟩, v, ?_, ?_⟩
   532          · rw [untuple_tuple]; exact hfs.2
   533          · rw [untuple_tuple]
   534  
   535  /-- **The fibre of constructor `j`** at the family `W` and the index
   536  values `is`: the constructor values of the fitting lists whose index
   537  expressions read as `is`. -/
   538  noncomputable def ctorFibre (W : List V → V) (ps is : List V) (j : Nat) (c : CtorSpec) : V :=
   539    open Classical in
   540    image (fun t => S.ctorVal ls j (untuple t))
   541      (sep (S.fitsSet M ls W ps c.fields) fun t =>
   542        is = S.idxVals M ls (consList (untuple t) (envP ps)) c.idx)
   543  
   544  /-- **The block's operator** on families: the fibre at `is` is the
   545  union over the constructors of their fibres.  Con-leche: the hole
   546  operator `holeOp` (`BlockDatum.lean`), the operator of
   547  `LfpClause.functor`. -/
   548  noncomputable def famOp (ps : List V) (W : List V → V) (is : List V) : V :=
   549    listUnion ((List.range S.n).map fun j => S.ctorFibre M ls W ps is j (S.ctors.getD j ⟨"", [], []⟩))
   550
